new: Reorder only when order is observable (recommended). The planner marks Optional / Apply-optional / Optional Conditional Traverse `preserve_order` unless an order-insensitive consumer sits above, such as an `Aggregate` with no order-sensitive function (`collect`) or a `Sort`. Unmarked plans keep today's streaming at zero cost. Marked plans use the `FallbackOrder` mechanics above.
